name: YouthPlayerRegistrationConsole
tagline: Season registration, consents, fees and team allocation for youth clubs – one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: A complete youth registration app for clubs, academies and school sports programmes: age groups from date of birth and the season cut-off, parent/guardian, medical and photo consents, proof of age and previous-club clearance checks, fees with instalments and sibling discount, overdue tracking, and drag-and-drop team allocation with girls/boys/mixed, playing-up and squad-size rules. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data out of the box.
features: Age group = U(age on cut-off + 1), configurable cut-off and age range
Guardian, medical and photo consent with one-tap recording
Proof of age and previous-club clearance checks
Status workflow with business rules and reasons (draft, submitted, on hold, approved, allocated, withdrawn)
Drag-and-drop team allocation with gender, playing-up and squad-size rules
Fee schedule by age band, instalments, sibling discount, overdue after grace days
Record payments and waivers with undo
Bulk approve, remind families (JSON payload for email flows), export CSV
No-photo-consent list for the media team
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
